title: Swarm: topology (role-annotated nodes + the Portainer service)
description: Runs `nexus topology swarm`. Each manager is annotated consul-server/nomad-server, each worker consul-client/nomad-client/portainer-agent, plus a Portainer service node (best-effort endpoint count or version). Not sharded.

observe.what: 6 nodes role-annotated (manager/raft-leader|reachable + consul-server,nomad-server / worker + consul-client,nomad-client,portainer-agent) + a portainer (swarm service) node

whatProves: SwarmAdapter.TopologyAsync renders the orchestration-tier shape from docker node ls + Portainer reachability; Shards = null (the tier is not data-sharded).
